{{Top|leg}}
The '''Galactic Swoop Racing Circuit''' was a [[Swoop racing/Legends|swoop racing]] circuit that included several high-profile [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] races on a number of world including [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] and [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]]. The circuit was disturbed when the [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith]] bombed Taris during the [[Jedi Civil War]].
